mapper.sql: id, name, country, city, website, ranking_tier, logo_document_id, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark

mapper.update: update nad_university set name = #{name}, country = #{country}, city = #{city}, website = #{website}, ranking_tier = #{rankingTier}, logo_document_id = #{logoDocumentId}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(), remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
